transport.resume: Query `since=<sequence>` or header `Last-Event-ID`. Server replays redacted events with sequence > since from the outbox (bounded to the last 500); if the requested sequence is older than retained, it emits `system.snapshot_required`.
transport.heartbeat: comment frame every 15 s; clients treat 45 s silence as disconnected (E12) and reconnect.
transport.skipMarker: id: <sequence>\n\n - sent instead of an event when the outbox row is not visible to this audience/participant (redaction). It carries no data and dispatches no event; clients set last = sequence so filtered streams never see a false gap. Sequence numbers are shared by all audiences of an eventId.

clientRules: Track the last applied sequence; ignore sequence <= last. An id-only skip marker advances last without dispatching an event.
On sequence gap (> last + 1) fetch the audience snapshot and set last = snapshot.sequence.
Apply only the fields present in the audience projection contract; never infer private data.
Animations may interpolate but the final visual state always equals the snapshot/event state; replays after reconnect never re-trigger celebrations (motion contract).

payload.startOverdue: bool (optional; system actor, no version change)

payload.reason: incomplete|late|cancelled (late = draft saved after lock; reassigned when the next round opens)

SoulPrivate.config: SoulConfig (v3) for Souls created from contract 1.2.0 on; SoulConfigV2 for Souls created under 1.1.0 and for the neutral fallback; SoulConfigV1 for Souls created before 1.1.0

SoulEntrance.config: SoulConfig (v3) for Souls created from contract 1.2.0 on; SoulConfigV2 for Souls created under 1.1.0 and for the neutral fallback; SoulConfigV1 for Souls created before 1.1.0. Public and stage get the same config as the owner: its decoration is charm ids, face, face plate, eyes, antenna charm and gradient, never skill ids, skill names or match counts
SoulEntrance.label: string|null

SoulConfig.version: 3 (contract 1.2.0, D-31, docs/art/soul-faces.md). Built once at round end by packages/game-rules/src/soul.js decoratedSoulConfig and checked by validateSoulConfig; exactly these keys, in this order, for every audience. Clients branch on version: SoulConfigV2 and SoulConfigV1 stay valid for stored Souls
SoulConfig.catalog: int 2..current: version of packages/game-rules/src/soul-catalog.js that the charm, plate and eye ids refer to (plates and eyes exist from catalog 2)
SoulConfig.gradient: int 0..11: catalog body gradient, picked from the seed (all gradients share one mean brightness)
SoulConfig.glow: int 0..2: glow style, picked from the seed
SoulConfig.face: nerdy|pirate|angel: the face kit, from the kind with the most matched tiles at round end (ties core > technical > soft, no matches -> nerdy); never null
SoulConfig.plate: string: catalog face plate id (soul-catalog.js PLATE_IDS), picked from the seed
SoulConfig.eyes: string: catalog eye design id (soul-catalog.js EYE_IDS), picked from the seed
SoulConfig.charms: string[]: catalog charm ids, index = slot; exactly slotCount (10) distinct ids, split across core / technical / soft in proportion to the selected skills' kinds, variants and order from the seed
SoulConfig.topper: string: the antenna charm that replaces the orb, a catalog charm id picked from the seed among the charms not in charms (random, never derived from skills)
SoulConfig.constellation: [{domain, weight 0..1}] top 5 selected-skill domains (accent placement only)

SoulConfigV2.version: 2: Souls created under contract 1.1.0 (D-29, docs/art/soul-decorations.md; packages/game-rules/src/soul.js SOUL_CONFIG_SCHEMA_V2), and the neutral fallback any Soul gets when its decoration fails (packages/game-rules/src/soul.js neutralSoulConfig: face null, charms [], gradient 0, glow 0). Still valid; exactly these keys
SoulConfigV2.catalog: int 1..current: version of packages/game-rules/src/soul-catalog.js that the charm ids refer to
SoulConfigV2.face: nerdy|pirate|angel as SoulConfig; null only in the neutral fallback
SoulConfigV2.charms: string[]: as SoulConfig (slotCount ids); [] in the neutral fallback

SoulConfigV1.version: 1: Souls created before contract 1.1.0 (packages/game-rules/src/soul.js SOUL_CONFIG_SCHEMA); still valid, rendered as the plain baseline with their palette
